record.scope: Passenger and trade movement initially restricted

record.exceptions: Afghan returnees from Pakistan on 6–9 April; subsequent scheduled Pakistan-to-Afghanistan cargo. Later May schedule retained from baseline.
record.enforcement: See claim-level evidence and source notes; order dates and observed operation distinguished.
record.relationship: Related national western-border policy and Chaman phase SA003; category-specific easing is not a separate closure episode.
record.status_observation: Afghan returnees crossed on 6 April 2020; one-way cargo resumed 10 April on a limited schedule; full ordinary reopening not established.
record.context: Pakistan's COVID restriction was progressively relaxed by movement category. The date recorded as end is an actual returnee exception, not the end of the entire regime.
record.uncertainty: No full ordinary passenger/trade reopening date established. Planned two-week expiry is not an operational endpoint. Pakistan imposed the initial restriction; this is not an Afghan-side closure order.

historical.duration_note: Not eligible for a single continuous-duration calculation; see movement scope, phases and uncertainty. Do not calculate a total closure duration across changing exemptions or a legal-permission endpoint.
